policy.freshDefault: High/native/complete for fresh desktop and coarse-pointer profiles. Any existing graphics preference preserves the existing customized resolution/effects/animation rules.
policy.low: Disable combat/decorative effect adapters, projectiles/beams/muzzle flashes/hit/explosion/trails, birth/death extras, environment particles, pickup decorations, barrier and hit overlays, bloom, refraction, real-time PCF and contact shadows. Keep physical unit/pickup models, model materials, complete actions, simple ground shadows, health bars and interaction UI.
policy.danger: One static frame of original fx.acid.0 texture projected on terrain, clipped to native harmful footprints. No added visible sphere, ring, box, outline or solid-fill geometry marker. Plane mesh is only a texture carrier. Nominal footprints do not replace native body-radius or line-of-sight collision rules.
policy.medium: Previously approved medium policy retained; no new medium-vs-high GPU measurement in this supplement.
policy.high: Complete effects remain available. Same-state high/low/high restoration verified.
policy.simulation: Damage, trajectories, movement, AI, fixed-step schedule, RNG, production, 300 and 4:4:1 remain unchanged. One read-only native packet-ownership query added for correct danger classification after caster capture or removal.
policy.saved: Low persists across reload; exact old medium combination upgrades as before; existing custom settings preserved.

nativeInput.scope: Separate from the six already-finished timing windows; actual keyboard resume, D movement, release and Escape pause.

measurement.normalization: runId, notice and noticeUntil omitted; only the UUID part of the stage-one support receipt normalized for independent new runs. All other serialized run/status/special fields compared exactly.

notes: All 85 source pictures were inspected through the generated contact sheets and targeted original-resolution images.
The six R6 hero and five map high/low/high restoration pairs are RGB exact; the earlier six R5 pairs are separately retained and also exact.
Low/full differences are intentional and visible. Native models, complete poses, health bars and actual interceptor bodies remain; warning texture footprints are visible across all five maps.
The actual warning captures and standalone 10-patch material image show static original texture marks, without added visible geometric volumes, circles, boxes, outlines or solid fills.
Screens for the old network failure, loading shader failures, R5 state-identity assertion and supplemental low-context shader failure are retained and reviewed.

Three responsive settings sizes, reload, custom/legacy values, coarse-pointer settings and seven normal-run/end-input images were reviewed. End-run pause pictures are not used as combat-frame visual comparisons.

recoveryAssistance.scope: Supplemental native Retry button during the main runner context-low recovery wait. The original shader timeout is retained; no deadline or game code changed.
